query:
The group reached a position on whether the Christmas Day gathering should include people outside the immediate family. What did the group decide, and what did Kingsley's response to that decision signal about his actual position on it?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kingsley
C. Chisom
D. Tobenna
context:
[1] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:45:00) Kingsley. A pre-Christmas gathering at your property is a separate matter. The Christmas Day gathering itself is family. I trust you understand the distinction I am making.
[2] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:22:00) Greetings. Christmas Day should be family only. Chisom is wise to wait. In our family, we have always believed that a man who meets the family in haste leaves in haste also. January is correct.
[3] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:40:00) Aunty, hear me out. I'm definitely coming. Ifeoma too, I'll drag her up from Bristol personally if I have to 😂 Also while we're planning, and I know this is early, I know, but what about a pre-Christmas drinks thing at mine in South London? Open it up a bit. I've got space.
[4] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:48:00) yeah yeah of course Aunty Oby, the pre-drinks would just be family and a couple of close friends, nothing mad. details, details - anyway I'll sort the date and drop it in the chat 🎄
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[6] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Greetings my people, good afternoon. I write to raise something before it becomes too late to plan properly. Christmas is nine weeks away. I wish to know how we are handling the gathering this year, who is hosting, who is bringing what, and I am asking now so that there are no surprises at the last minute.
[7] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:03:00) Chisom, I am glad you understand. This is a matter of how we have always operated as a family. Your grandfather insisted that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, the meal shared without rushing. That is what Christmas means in this family.
[8] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:58:00) okay SO I'm in for both 🙌 pre-drinks AND Christmas. Aunty Oby I love how you said Funmi is practically one of us already lmao we been knew. also Kingsley please actually set a date I am begging
[9] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:52:00) I am coming to Christmas, Aunty Nkechi, I already blocked the dates. Kingsley I think what might help here is you confirm a specific date for the pre-Christmas thing rather than leaving it open, otherwise it just won't happen.
[10] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:37:00) My sister. Thank you for that. Funmi has been part of this family for seven years, she is family. 🙏 Kingsley, I assume you are coming. And your sister?
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) The family confirms attendance for Christmas in Reading: Emeka, Funmi, and kids; Adaeze; Chisom; Tobenna; Kingsley; Ifeoma; Obiageli via video call.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Obiageli, group-interaction, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Obiageli raises the need to plan the Christmas gathering, nine weeks away, asking who is hosting and who is bringing what, to avoid last-minute surprises.
[13] (about=Kingsley, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Kingsley proposes a pre-Christmas drinks gathering at his place in South London, open to family and a couple of close friends, and will sort the date and drop it in the chat.

B. Adaeze
C. Tobenna
D. Chisom
